name: sparkee
description: 极简闪念速记：Cloudflare Workers + D1 + Preact PWA
author: Tribbtsz

scripts.build:web: pnpm --dir web install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm --dir web build
scripts.deploy: pnpm run build:web && pnpm --dir worker install --frozen-lockfile && node worker/scripts/build-secrets.mjs && pnpm --dir worker exec cf deploy --secrets-file secrets.env
scripts.preview: pnpm run build:web && pnpm --dir worker install --frozen-lockfile && node worker/scripts/build-secrets.mjs && pnpm --dir worker exec cf previews deploy --secrets-file secrets.env
